  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    AltaStataEventListener
    Listener interface for handling general AltaStata events.
    OperationStateChangeListener
    Listener interface for monitoring changes in the OperationState of a cloud operation.
    ProgressValueChangeListener
    Listener interface for receiving progress value change events during file operations.
    StreamStartedListener
    Listener interface for receiving events indicating that a data stream has started.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AccountId
    Immutable identity of an AltaStata account, used as the key of AccountRegistry.
    AccountRegistry
    Process-wide registry that maps an AccountId to its single, shared AltaStataFileSystem instance.
    AltaStataChannelEncryptionService
    Provides channel-level buffer encryption and decryption using AES-GCM.
    AltaStataEvent
    General event class for notifications within the AltaStata platform.
    AltaStataFileSystem  
    CloudFileOperationStatus
    Represents the status and progress of an asynchronous cloud file operation.
    OperationStateChangeEvent
    Event representing a state transition in a cloud file operation (e.g., UPLOADING to DONE).
    ProgressValueChangeEvent
    Event containing progress updates (0 to 1) for an active file operation.
    StreamStartedEvent
    Event notifying that the first data chunk of a streaming file has been successfully processed (uploaded or downloaded), signaling the start of a stream.
